description: MiaAI-Lab's pinned dev-dsv41 base profile at 64b02dea8681fb1d8e3a659ea432a8e9e9ba3995: native MXFP4 experts, DSpark 5 and NVMe Engram on 4 Sparks. Uses the creator's base image and adapters, including SM121 attention and chat-history repair. All ranks read Controller-managed local checkpoint files; the upstream row store reads Engram directly from those immutable files. Does not use host NFS, packed Engram copies, display-reservation memory or the optional canary RoCEnante image. Memory and throughput remain upstream estimates; physical Spark acceptance is unmeasured.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 SGLang 4 Sparks (Mia)
